The fix works. Summary:

**Root cause:** `paths.PathEscape` (common/paths/path.go:377) uses `url.Parse`, which treats `#` and `?` in a generated file path as URL fragment/query delimiters, so `u.EscapedPath()` truncated the path at the `#` (e.g. `/posts/2024/04/newsletter-#4/index.html` → `/posts/2024/04/newsletter-`).

**Fix:** Pre-escape `#` → `%23` and `?` → `%3F` before parsing in `PathEscape` so they survive as literal path characters.

**Validation:** `TestHashSignInPermalink` (resources/page/path_integration_test.go) passes, asserting both the published files (`public/s1/p#1/index.html`, etc.) and the escaped `RelPermalink`s (`/s1/p%231/`). All other suites that can run offline (`helpers`, `common/paths`, `resources/...`, `tpl/urls`) still pass; `hugolib` tests fail to set up only because `github.com/fortytw2/leaktest` is missing from the module cache and the network is blocked — unrelated to this change.
